title: Hitler's World War I poems to Odin and Thor

tellings.quote: >> and wasn't Hitler writing poetry to the Nordic gods and as a soldier in World War I? >> Yes, he was. He wrote it. They're reprinted in I think it's Tolen's biography of Hitler.

plain: As a soldier in the First World War, Adolf Hitler is said to have written poems to the old Norse gods. When Michels asks about it, the author Peter Levenda says yes, Hitler wrote them, and they are reprinted, he thinks, in John Toland's biography of Hitler. It comes up as a sign that Hitler had a religious, pagan side long before he came to power.
